none: PAS NLM-00D5D7: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), an irregular fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right, large eye. Obverse inscription: [--]IVS COCENSS. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman; stick figures. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight: 1.76gms, die…
